# Inbox
{: .no_toc }

Every notification the person has received — from every app and from Substratal — with read and archived state.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `NTF-01` |
| **Route** | `/inbox` · deep link `substratal://inbox` |
| **Where** | Personal › Inbox |
| **Who can use it** | Self |
| **Kind** | list |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (Phase 2) |
| **On Linux** | Nested `AdwNavigationSplitView` list pane |

**How you get here:** Bell in the toolbar / Inbox in the sidebar (desktop) / Inbox tab (compact); Tapping a push; Badges (app icon, Dock/taskbar, PWA)

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter | segmented | Unread · All · Archived (state) | default All (unarchived) | linked GtkToggleButtons |
| App filter | menu | application_id, source=platform ("Substratal") | per-app unread counts from unread-count.applications[] | GtkMenuButton |
| Rows | list | Notification: app icon (or Substratal mark for source=platform), title, body (2 lines), category, priority high → "Important" marker, created_at relative, unread dot | grouped Today / Yesterday / Earlier; high priority security.* rows show a shield icon | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Mark all as read | button | POST /users/me/notifications/mark-read {before: newest loaded created_at, application_id?} | respects current app filter; uses `before` so items arriving now aren't swept | GtkButton |
| Multi-select | selection |  | bulk Mark read / Mark unread / Archive (one PATCH per row) | AdwComboRow |
| Row actions | row-button | PATCH /users/me/notifications/{notificationId} {state} | swipe/hover: Read ⇄ Unread, Archive | suffix GtkButton .flat |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Open row | `→ NTF-02 and PATCH {state:read}` | optimistic; badge decrements |
| Archive | `PATCH /users/me/notifications/{notificationId} {state:archived}` | toast with Undo (PATCH state:read) |
| Mark read / unread | `PATCH /users/me/notifications/{notificationId} {state}` |  |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES; Empty: "You're all caught up"; Feature off (501 not_implemented): hide Inbox entry points; badges fall back to none; Retention: items older than 90 days disappear (caption in empty Archived view)
- The Inbox shows notifications from every Application plus platform alerts, but push banners for another app's notifications arrive through that app's own install — the Hub only pushes its own (`app_hub`) notifications and platform alerts.

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/me/notifications?state&application_id&source&category&priority&created_after&created_before&include_inactive` · `GET /users/me/notifications/unread-count` · `GET /applications (names, icons)`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
